DESIGN CHOICES / DEVIATIONS:
- Claim file is the sibling <run_dir>.CLAIM (not inside the run dir) because run.py refuses a non-empty out dir. States: absent, done, in_progress (live claim or other host), stale (dead pid, this host; released only by status --release-stale, which renames a partial dir to .interrupted<n>), failed_eval (left for rescore, never retried by run), failed_once (FAILED.json, no .attempt dir: retried), failed (FAILED.json + an .attempt dir: final), interrupted (dir without markers or claim: renamed .interrupted<n>, rerun).
- OOM = FAILED error/message with OutOfMemory / 'out of memory', or exit -9/137: the attempt is renamed and the run re-queued after the invocation's worker limit drops by one. A crash without FAILED.json gets a sweep-written FAILED.json {stage unknown, by sweep}.
- Shards are over the full seed-major ordered grid (all four spec indexes required for --shard). Non-smoke run refuses (exit 4) without results/go_function/code_pin.json.
- pin hashes every .py under go_function/ (tests included, __pycache__ excluded) and scripts/go_function/ and every .json under config/go_function/; it needs a clean `git status --porcelain` for those paths (read-only git) or --accept-content-pin; records G8 {code_pin.json sha, git_head, spec_sets}. Because pilot.py writes epochs_star into the tracked study.json, the user must commit study.json after G7 before pin (stated in the runbook).
- Audit: out_dir always differs; lambda_el is folded into 'variant' when it is exactly the EL/non-EL implication. Pairing rules: C1 V3->V3c; X->V0 for V1..V6 under W2/W1 (all regimes, both draws); C5 V6->V5; C3 WDGZrel->TP/W2; C3_leak WDGZrel->W2drop; C3_col W2drop->DGZ/W2; C3_reg DGZ/W2->TP/W2 (V0 and V4); W1->W2; draw 2->draw 1. Pair counts BP ESM: 205, 1691, 205, 40, 40, 40, 410, 360, 32. Specs per (aspect, feature): BP ESM 2,522 + InterPro 260 = 2,782; MF 2,897 + 260 = 3,157.
- Vbest tie rule read as 'the earlier-listed arm in V1..V6' (protocol 'lower-listed' is ambiguous).
- S1 hierarchical bootstrap is computed beside every family contrast and the two C3 values of the decomposition; descriptive reads use the two-way bootstrap only. Collateral harm uses run-level (pack x seed) cells with one bootstrap unit per pack, classified without Holm. The re-draw read uses a target-level bootstrap (S1 with one seed column).
